notes.title: Space Gladiators Full Release
notes.content:
Hello,

After more than 16 months of Early Access... [b]Space Gladiators is finally launching in version 1.0![/b]

Here's a quick summary of everything that's been added and changed during Early Access:

[list]
[*] [b]2 new characters[/b]
[*] [b]167 new items / perks / traits[/b]
[*] [b]21 new enemies[/b]
[*] [b]8 new traps[/b]
[*] [b]3 new minibosses[/b]
[*] [b]27 new challenges[/b]
[*] [b]393 new rooms[/b]
[*] Countless gameplay, design, balancing and bug fixes and improvements
[*] Added [b]stat modifiers[/b] to items
[*] Added the [b]map & procedural path generation[/b]
[*] Added [b]starting traits[/b] and [b]danger levels[/b]
[*] [b]Displayed the outfits[/b] on the characters
[*] Changed from individual zones to [b]only full runs[/b]
[*] [b]Removed enemy contact damage[/b] and reworked all enemies to account for that
[*] [b]Performance improvements[/b] with a dancing potato
[*] Added [b] localization in 8 other languages[/b]
[*] Added [b]trading cards[/b]
[/list]

Special thanks to Petra, Bear, Olexa, Rogue Justice, PentaHybrid, Traumaturgy, TheSpaceEgg, Funguy, Kenzup, Celt, Devildoer, Lyman, Swestar, Graeme of 2 Left Thumbs, 2 Lainz, JoueurSansFromage, Bestiyo, TheTurtleMelon, Giragnoulak, Idiosyncrazy, Lef, Esty, Sensei Bean, MadderThanEggs, Woodlutins, littleninja117, Soremon Sketch, DrFenouil, Blueish, Ixion, AguruAguru, Flounder, DarkLiveRyder, Fugu, Jean, Nublear, Dreamless, Ducky, D3, jason, drakan, Hibou Inquiet, Howard, Padongo, Hallow, Pepenosoy, Natalie Swirvin, Cimarus, EthanZ, Susucr, Moonboi, Himg, ingeniousclown, crazyred, pisun morza, mataos, kirakirby, ShoMG, hobbidwa, Papnix, Pielef...

Cheers!

We now have trading cards, emotes, backgrounds and badges for the game! Not totally sure how that works but you should be able to get some of them by just playing.

notes.title: Russian & Portuguese (BR)
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks to the work of some players, the game is now available in 2 more languages: Portuguese (BR) and Russian.

If you also want to help bring the game into your own language, feel free to head out to [url=https://www.localizor.com/space-gladiators]Localizor[/url] and start translating!

I also took the opportunity to push some bug fixes. I haven’t had as much time to work on the game lately, but Space Gladiators has already been in Early Access for more than a year now which is way more than I originally planned.

I still want to add some things but overall I’m pretty happy with the current state of the game. I think 1.0 is not that far off. 

I know some of you are hoping for more stuff like mod support, customized runs and such. It might come later but I can’t really promise anything there. 

The game has evolved way past its original scope and wasn’t supposed to include modding & stuff, so some of these functionalities would probably be way too hard to implement into the current codebase. I’ll only know for sure if I get the time to look into it more deeply though!

Special thanks to Bear (1), Rekengappy (2), Tijoe (3), Funguy (4) and everyone who helped with the translations!

notes.title: Space Gladiators is now on Localizor!
notes.content:
Hello,

Space Gladiators is now available on [url=https://www.localizor.com/space-gladiators]Localizor[/url], a website used for managing crowd-sourced translations! 

It has been recommended by a lot of other cool indie devs and it looked like a simple and elegant solution so I wanted to give it a try.

I spent the last few weeks fixing all the keys and translations inside of the game to make it easier to get external contributions. 

Here are the current languages available for translation:

[list]
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Russian
[*]Portuguese
[*]Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Spanish
[*]Polish
[/list]

If you're speaking one of those fluently and wanna help the game out, feel free to start contributing there! You'll only need to create a [url=https://www.localizor.com/]Localizor[/url] account and you'll be good to go. 

I also created [url=https://discord.gg/j39jE6k]a dedicated channel on the Discord server[/url] to keep organized and in case you need more info on anything so make sure to join us there!

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.7.2 - New Items, Balancing & Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35772788/56bb657b6da0ff81365ed34400f17296e74418b4.png[/img]

Hello,

This week’s been pretty crazy! I got a lot of feedback and I tried to implement most of it in this update. I also added 6 new items, fixed a lot of stuff and did some work on balancing the game.

One big problem that I kept seeing is that a lot of the time you could just facetank all of the enemies and outdamage them once you got a few good items. (namely Strong Bones, Green Energy Ball or a lot of Vampirism, HP and Metal Scraping)

I think I’ve pinpointed the issue: too many invincibility frames after you get hit. It means that enemies could never deal more damage than the amount you recovered - which made it very boring once you got to this point. 

It was even worse with Voubi because of the clones that acted basically like an additional Vampirism mechanic. That’s why I’m reducing the iframes by 25% in this update. (you’ll basically take 25% more damage if you facetank everything)

Voubi also got nerfed quite a bit. He’s definitely the hardest character to balance and he was pretty overpowered in version 0.7.1.

Anyway, feel free to check the full changelog below! And as usual, I’m looking forward to hear your thoughts about the changes.

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 - Subzones
notes.content:
Hello,

Welcome to the game’s biggest update yet! 

I’ve received a lot of feedback and ideas over the last 2 months and I tried my best to implement them.

The main goals of this update are twofold:
[list]
[*] Improve the diversity of the game with new subzones and hundreds of new rooms, traps and enemies
[*] Smooth out the gamefeel and difficulty curve of the game with improved movement and the removal of contact damage. 
[/list]

From now on, if an enemy doesn’t have a red aura it means [b]you can touch him without taking damage.[/b] A lot of behaviors have been obviously been reworked and rebalanced to account for that. 

We’re also trying out a new run structure: [b]all runs are now full runs. [/b]

A lot of people have suggested that the previous format of doing each zone individually felt weird. 

I’m not completetely discarding the idea of reintroducing the possibility of doing individual zones later on but we’ll see how it goes that way first.

[b]What’s next?[/b] After a few small patches to fix the bugs and balancing issues that’ll come up, here’s what I have planned for the next main updates:
[list]
[*] New characters.
[*] New event rooms and items.
[*] Also considering adding minibosses, but I'm not 100% convinced that'd be the best use of my time considering how much work it takes to make good ones.
[/list]

I actually wanted to implement most of these things in this update, but it was starting to take way too long so I decided to postpone them.

Special thanks to Rogue Justice (1), TheTurtleMelon (2), Lef (3), Giragnoulak (4) and mataos (5) for their suggestions!

[h2]New stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Every zone is now separated into 3 subzones with specific rooms and some specific enemies in each of them. The order of the subzones is randomised.
[*] Added 371 new rooms. 
[*] Added 8 new traps.
[*] Added 21 new enemies.
[*] Added 1 new item.
[*] Enemies no longer damage the player on contact by default.
[*] The boss fights have been reworked and tweaked.
[*] The “Select Zone” screen has been removed. All runs are now full runs. (2)
[*] Player movement and interactions with walls have been reworked and smoothed out. You don’t stick to walls while going up anymore and it’s easier to move around walls & corners or to grab small walls.
[*] Reduced the size of the item description boxes and redesigned them.
[*] The “Key” item has been replaced by the “Stun Device”.
[*] Added the “Fragile Heart” perk.
[*] Some NPC actions have been tweaked and more special rooms have been added.
[*] Added new destructibles.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked and rebalanced some enemies.
[*] The medic has been disabled.
[*] Genetic Containers attack pattern has been modified.
[*] The Wrench item now costs 50 coins to use instead of 25.
[*] The Thief trait has been buffed.
[*] The “Blood Donation” item now only has a 50% chance of making you lose 1 hp at the start of rooms (instead of 100%).
[*] The “Pet Trainer” perk now increases pet damage by 50% instead of 100%.
[*] The “Cyclops” pet damage has been decreased.

notes.content:
Hello,

This update has 2 main goals (apart from fixing bugs).

The first goal is to allow different styles of play that are focused on increasing your coins, speed, jump height etc. instead of just strength and technology. 

20 new perks, items and traits have been added for that purpose.

The second goal is to improve how items and stats changes feel on your character. 

It basically means displaying the damage numbers on hit, improving some visual effects and displaying armors on your characters!

Doing all that required quite a lot of back-end work to be done. All player assets had to be reworked and the characters are now drawn to the screen in layers - amongst other things.

Do note that armors are not displayed yet on some characters (Robbie & Voubi). It took way longer than I expected and it’s not feasible to do it the same way for those two. 

I have ideas on how to circumvent the issue but I don’t think it’s a priority right now if we take into consideration how much time it takes.

notes.title: Update 0.6.1 - Graphics, Enemy Redesigns & Fixes
notes.content:
Hello,

Here’s the first update of the year! 

It’s mainly a graphical one. I improved the design of some of the enemies and replaced them completely in a few cases. 

The goal is to remove old sprites I had spent only a few minutes putting together (e.g. the ghost) and that didn’t feel like they belonged in an alien planet. I’m trying to steer the art direction of the game toward something more unique and specific to the game’s context.

I also reworked the background elements. Quite a few people pointed out that the enemies were blending in too much with their environment and were sometimes hard to see. 

This update marks only the beginning of these design reworks. There’s a lot I want to do in that regard, but I’ll try to sprinkle it during the next weeks/months alongside gameplay and content additions. 

Talking about gameplay, I noticed that very few players were using shields - so I made them better! They now protect you from all sides and not just from front attacks.

Voubi’s cloning system also seemed a bit too hard and frustrating to play. He now clones himself every 8 hits with no limits per room.

Finally, I fixed a bunch of bugs. There are still a few of them that have been reported and that aren’t fixed yet. I’m working on it and I’ll include them in the updates as soon as they’re fixed.

Special thanks to Giragnoulak (1), JoueurSansFromage (2) and pisun morza (3) for their suggestions!

notes.title: Update 0.6.0 - Map, Events, Traits & Danger
notes.content:
Hello,

Big update today! This one took quite a bit of time. 

I probably should have separated the features in multiple little updates… but now that we’re here, let’s see what it’s all about!

The biggest change is that the game now procedurally generates multiple possible paths to get to the arenas. You can choose which rooms you want to go with the help of a newly created map system.

For those who have finished the game, there is now new content to beat! This update introduces the Danger levels, which are basically new levels of difficulties.

Note that you’ll have to finish a full run at Danger level 0 before unlocking the next Danger level for that character, even if you have finished a full run before.

Beating Danger levels will unlock new Traits, which are also a new addition - you get one random trait everytime you start a run.

The last big change I’ll talk about is the new Event room type. They’re inhabited by cute NPCs with whom you’ll be able to interact to get specific bonuses and effects.

I also have a pretty clear idea about what the next updates might be about. That includes (in no specific order):
[list]
[*] Redoing the enemies AI to allow more diversity in their behavior and adding new enemies.
[*] Adding a ton of new rooms, traits and perks to differentiate the runs from each other.
[*] New items that’ll allow more sophisticated and exotic builds to be viable.
[*] Adding mini bosses and more challenging optional rooms between arenas.
[*] Adding sub zones that’ll allow you to go through a different biome to get the boss of the zone.
[*] And more!
[/list]

Anyway, I’ll leave it at that for now. Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Update 0.5.3 - Smooth Jumps
notes.content:
This update aims at fixing issues some players have pointed out. 

It’ll hopefully make the jump feel more controllable, cement Patato as “the easiest character to play” that he’s designed to be and fix some other things.

Special thanks to “Peredur Gargantaur” (1), “Giragnoulak” (2) and “DrFenouil” (3) for their suggestions!

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] Hitting your head against a roof while jumping no longer makes you fall instantly.  (1)
[*] You no longer take damage from enemies or canon bullets while you’re dashing. (1)
[*] You no longer get pushed away when you’re jumping next to a wall while on the ground. (1)
[*] Patato’s base Strength and Energy Damage have been increased from 5 to 8. (2)
[*] Patato’s base Vampirism has been reduced from 10 to 5. (2)
[*] The Metal Canon now costs 2 Energy points to use. (2)
[*] The skin of the Spitter projectile has been modified to be more visible. (2)
[*] Mushroom King will no longer teleport on platforms and traps have been added. (2)
[*] Reduced the number of ghosts that Lost Soul can spawn and they now have 1 hp. (2)
[*] The description of the Bomb has been updated. (3)
[*] Vampirism is now capped at 15, except for Babouk. (3)
[*] The Vampirism given by some items has been reduced. (3)
[*] Enemy placement in some rooms has been modified to avoid colliding with them directly after entering. (3)
[*] The Heart will no longer appear in your cell if you’re playing Robbie. (3)
[*] The Ninja Doll effects have been modified.
[*] The Assassin Doll effects have been modified.
[*] Metal Scraping is now capped at 20.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2 - Introducing the Medic
notes.content:
Hello,

Another day, another update. Today we're most notably adding the Medic, nerfing Lost Soul and fixing things!

Full changelog:
[list]
[*]Added the Medic: he will bring you back to life the first time you die to a boss in a run. This is meant to alleviate the runs where you get to the boss just to die because you don’t know their pattern, and actually give you a chance to finish the run the first time you meet them.
[*] Added a link to the Discord server in the menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player didn’t spawn the run after leaving the tutorial in some cases.
[*] Fixed the display of boss names in some resolutions.
[*] Added the image of the perk rewarded after beating an arena above its description.
[*] An Ankh now appears before boss fights (Golden Tools if you’re playing Robbie).
[*] The speed of Lost Soul has been reduced.
[*] Lost Soul no longer gets healed with his projectile if it’s hitting your shield.
[*] Lost Soul’s attack cooldown has been increased.
[*] Consumables that appear before arenas are now different if you’re playing Robbie.
[*] Fixed the health bar of little rats.
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
12 hours after the Early Access Release and I already gathered enough feedback for a small update!

The main goal of this patch is to adjust the difficulty of The Hole (way too hard and frustrating for a first level), aswell as add a bunch of new rooms.

Here's the full changelog:
[list]
[*] Added 5 new monster rooms in The Hole.
[*] There is one less room between each arena.
[*] Items sold by shops are now ~17% cheaper.
[*] The number of simultaneous enemies in the arenas of The Hole & The Colosseum has been reduced by 1.
[*] The number of enemies in some of the arenas have been reduced.
[*] A healing consumable will now appear before each arena.
[*] The health of Rats has been reduced from 30 to 20.
[*] The health of Little Rats has been reduced from 20 to 10.
[*] The speed of Little Rats has been reduced.
[*] Little rats now have a red aura on them to be more easily seen.
[*] The health of Ghouls has been reduced from 30 to 25.
[*] The health of Zombie Ogres has been decreased from 60 to 50.
[*] The health of Zombies has been decreased from 40 to 30.
[*] The health of Zombies with Arrows has been decreased from 30 to 20.
[*] The attack cooldown of Ghouls has been increased.
[*] Changed the design of canon bullets and saws.
[*] The health of the bosses of The Hole has been reduced by 100.
[*] The chance of finding fruits in destructibles has been increased from 12% to 15%.
[*] Some rooms in The Hole have been modified.
[*] Shields are now faster to use.
[/list]

Cheers!
